environment.note: Static CSS and JS on beta load without a login. Prototypes always link them live; never copy or inline production CSS.

rules.note: DESIGN-SYSTEM.md is in a private repo. In Cowork or Claude Code, read it from a Foundant/glm checkout; in chat, ask for it as an attachment or use the kitchen sink.

icons.note: Production's curated Font Awesome Pro 7 subset. An icon missing from it renders a placeholder circle, exactly as it would in GLM.

shells.use: Admin pages inside the white page container: lists, search results, settings, process pages.

The Entity Summary page (DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, Layout): side panel nav, record header and content area. Request, Organization, User and Foundation Summary pages, and the Process Manager behind the Update Process preview. Structure follows the shipped *Container.cshtml views, not the DESIGN-SYSTEM.md tree.
Applicant-facing pages: the lighter applicant header, a form or dashboard in the page container.

behaviors.toast: GLM.Toast.showToast('GlobalToast', header, body); also showInfoToast, showWarningToast, showErrorToast
behaviors.slidePanel: GLM.SlidePanel.open({ title, content, width }); GLM.SlidePanel.close(). Use open with static HTML; load() needs a GLM server.
behaviors.mdb: Production loads MDB's explicit-init build. Components need their data-mdb-*-init attribute (dropdown, collapse, tab, modal, tooltip).
behaviors.sideNavigation: GLM.SideNavigation.initContainerLayout('.panel-header-wrapper', '.panel-header-desktop') and GLM.SideNavigation.initSidePanelFades(); the entity-summary shell already calls both.
